description: Camden Cycle Hangars is a dataset listed in London Borough of Camden open data portal (opendata.camden.gov.uk), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by London Borough of Camden. Installed and proposed/planned cycle hangars in Camden. Coverage: London Borough of Camden. The portal files it under the category Transport. The table has 20 columns. Attribution on the portal: London Borough of Camden. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence v3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-camden-gov-uk-portal.
